en.text: Function of Price

zh.text: 價格的功能

en.text: Peter Pang is an indigenous male resident in the New Territories. Which of the following are guided by price signals?

zh.text: 彭樹德是一位男性新界原居民。下列哪些是由價格訊息指導的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
He buys a concessionary house (丁屋) from his cousin.

zh.text: 他向堂兄購買一幢「丁屋」。

en.text: He is given a red packet by the Indigenous Inhabitant Representative (原居民代表) during the Lunar New Year.

zh.text: 在農曆新年時，他獲「原居民代表」分派紅封包。

en.text: He rents one of his concessionary houses to a tenant who is not an indigenous resident.

zh.text: 他將名下的其中一幢「丁屋」出租給一位非原居民。

en.text: HKDSE Sample Paper Paper 1 Q10

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 10 題

en.text: A famous artist, Tsz-Wah, held a show. Many people complained that they could not buy a ticket. Ticket touts resold the tickets on the Internet and some buyers paid a price higher than HK$10 000 for a ticket.

zh.text: 著名藝人子華舉辦了一場表演，很多人抱怨未能購得門票。門票黃牛黨在互聯網上轉售這些門票，有買家付出高於港幣 $10 000 購入一張門票。

en.text: The above case illustrates the ______ function of price because ______.

zh.text: 上述個案說明了價格的 ________ 功能，因為 ________。

en.text: rationing ... the tickets are rationed to the highest-valued buyers

zh.text: 配給……這些門票配給予最高價值的買家

en.text: rationing ... demand will be reduced by a higher price

zh.text: 配給……價格愈高，需求便會下降

en.text: allocative ... more profits can be earned with a higher price

zh.text: 分配……價格愈高，利潤便會增加

en.text: allocative ... more resources should be allocated to the producer to raise the supply

zh.text: 分配……更多的資源應該分配予生產商以增加供應

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q12

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 12 題

en.text: In recent years, the rise in demand for private cars in China has attracted Volkswagen, a German car manufacturer, to set up car manufacturing factories in China.

zh.text: 近年，中國對私家車的需求上升，這吸引了福士汽車（一家德國汽車製造商）在中國開設汽車製造工廠。

en.text: The above case illustrates the __________ function of price because __________.
rationing ... private cars are sold to the highest-valued users in China

zh.text: 配給……在中國，私家車賣給最高價值的用家

en.text: rationing ... fewer buyers are willing to buy private cars in Germany

zh.text: 配給……在德國，較少買家願意購買私家車

en.text: allocative ... the supply of private cars falls in Germany

zh.text: 分配……在德國，私家車的供應下降

en.text: allocative ... more resources are allocated to the production of private cars in China

zh.text: 分配……在中國，更多的資源投放在私家車的生產上
